subject: Ariba identity proofing + MSA redlines — PO field mapping
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medcohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: vendor-portal@medcohealth.com
Date: 2027-03-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ariba enrollment + MSA redlines — initial questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting Ariba enrollment for Redwood and have a couple of items that are blocking our portal team: identity proofing (what legal entity fields you will provide), PO number format (we require 12-digit numeric PO numbers for automated matching), and a handful of MSA redlines our procurement legal team flagged.

I've attached a spreadsheet with the fields our onboarding tool requires and a sample PO. Can you confirm:
- Which legal entity name exactly will appear on invoices (company name + DBA if any)?
- Will Redwood provide Tax ID / VAT fields via the registration?
- Do you have a programmatic prefix we should expect on POs (for example REDW-)?

Our procurement ops lead (vendor-portal@medcohealth.com) is in CC and would prefer we get this solved in the next 72 hours so the portal activation isn't delayed.

Attachment: MedCo_Ariba_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: MedCo_PO_Sample.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Samira Khan
Senior Procurement Manager
MedCo Health

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medcohealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-03-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba enrollment + MSA redlines — initial questions

Samira — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (supplier ops) and Marissa (contracts) so we can cover both the portal fields and the MSA redline path.

Quick answers up front:
- Company name for invoices: "Redwood Inference, Inc." — no DBA.
- Tax ID: yes, Redwood will provide EIN and VAT fields during registration; see mapping below.
- PO prefix: our billing system can accept a 12-digit numeric PO, we can also accept MEDC- prefixed POs but would like to avoid changing our AP flow. Can you confirm whether your matching requires strictly numeric?

Ben — can you draft the field mapping to match Samira's spreadsheet and confirm which fields we can populate from our registration payload vs what the portal would need to collect?

Marissa — procurement sent over a set of redlines to the MSA. If you can review and advise whether we should route straight to DocuSign or negotiate the exceptions first, that would be helpful. I expect a short legal summary to escalate to our security/legal if there are data residency or audit-log asks.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medcohealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-03-09T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Ariba enrollment + MSA redlines — initial questions

Hi Samira / team — attached is a quick field mapping and notes from our onboarding tech lead. Summary:
- Redwood registration payload will populate: legalName -> "Redwood Inference, Inc.", taxId -> "12-3456789" (EIN), vatNumber -> blank unless customer-specific VAT required, address -> HQ address.
- Portal-required fields we can't pre-populate due to identity proofing: corporate contact phone (we can suggest a default), vendor registration contact (we will supply a designated contact), and certificate uploads (we can provide SOC2 attestation link, not the file).
- PO format: our AP system supports both 12-digit numeric and alpha-numeric with a prefix; however, our automated matching currently expects the last 12 characters to be numeric. If MedCo requires a strictly numeric-only PO we will need to add a small parsing rule on our side. That change would be low risk but we'd like to scope it now.

Action items I propose:
1) MedCo to confirm whether automated matching will only accept strictly numeric 12-digit POs or if alpha prefixes are allowed (we can map).
2) MedCo to confirm required identity fields that must be validated during registration (we flagged phone / certificate / tax ID).
3) Marissa to review MSA redline summary and highlight any data-residency / audit log clauses that need Security review.

Attachment: MedCo_Ariba_Questions.xlsx (updated mapping tab)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Supplier Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

From: vendor-portal@medcohealth.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba enrollment + MSA redlines — PO format and identity fields

Ben / Irene — thanks for the mapping. We chatted with our portal team; summary below:
- PO matching: our AP system will accept MEDC-123456789012 and 123456789012. We can configure the parser to strip non-numeric prefixes, so alpha prefixes are OK as long as the trailing 12 chars are numeric. That should keep things compatible.
- Identity proofing: required fields for automated activation are legalName, taxId, corporateAddress, and a site-level contact email + phone. Certificate uploads are optional but procurement wants a SOC2 link + attestation PDF; we'll accept a link to your hosted report and the attestation upload.
- MSA redlines: procurement has highlighted three problem clauses (data residency, subprocessor notification windows, and audit scope). They want a short summary of our positions before they sign the portal waiver.

We've attached a short annotated sample PO and the portal checklist for your tech team.

Attachment: MedCo_PO_Sample_annotated.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Portal_Checklist_Ariba.txt (txt)

Samira K. (on behalf of MedCo Vendor Portal)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medcohealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-03-11T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba enrollment + MSA redlines — legal summary & next steps

Samira / team — Markus from Legal here. I reviewed the redlines and sketched a short playbook attached. Key points:
1) Data residency: Redwood's standard position is to provide export assurances and to support regional deployments under Private plan where required. For MedCo's standard procurement language we can commit to processing location controls as a contractual option; suggest we offer a 90-day implementation SLA if they pick regional private deployment.
2) Subprocessors: we will accept 15-day notification for critical subprocessors but need 30-day notice for non-critical to preserve our vendor management timelines. We propose to track exceptions in a simple appendix.
3) Audit scope: we can offer SOC2 report access + a scoped on-site audit for specific controls with mutual scheduling; for portal onboarding we will provide hosted SOC2 link and a redacted attestation PDF.

Next steps:
- Marissa will prepare a redline packet (MSA_redline_summary_20270311.docx) with highlighted concessions and a cover memo for MedCo.
- If MedCo agrees to the regional deployment option or the subprocessors appendix, we can proceed to a DocuSign packet for signature.

For the Ariba registration itself, Ben will adjust the registration payload to ensure taxId and contact phone are supplied. Marissa — I'll need your short cover memo by EOD tomorrow so Samira can present the summary to procurement.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_redline_summary_20270311.docx (docx)
